newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador refuses resignation of central bank head.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador refuses resignation of central bank head.

text.p: The Ecuadorean government on Thursday ratified Augusto De la Torre as head of the Central Bank after refusing to accept his resignation, a senior government source said.
"He presented the resignation because of different viewpoints, but the Finance Minister didn't accept it," the source told Reuters.
He added that De la Torre will meet President Abdala Bucaram on Monday, but declined to give details.
When Bucaram took office on August 10, he asked De la Torre to remain in the post he held during the government of former President Sixto Duran Ballen.
Local and foreign investors see De la Torre as important for ensuring continuity in Ecuador's monetary and foreign exchange policies.
